style: Say in an easy-going, encouraging way, like a relaxed sports coach
lines: Welcome to the gym! You count the bounces, and the computer counts them too. Tap a ball. Then press Drop.
Every time the ball hits the floor, say bounce, and tap the hand!
The pad on the floor is a sensor. It feels every hit and tells the computer.
Which ball is the bounciest? Point to your guess. Then tap that ball on the card.
Now tap a ball and press Drop. Drop every ball, one at a time.
Did you count on paper? Tap plus or minus to show your count.
The computer counted the same as you! Nice counting!
You counted fewer than the computer. Look for the yellow circles. Those are the bounces you missed.
You counted more than the computer. The gray circles are extra taps.
The bounces got small and fast at the end. Those are the hardest to count.
Again! The computer got the same number. It counts the same way every time.
Bouncy ball: the computer counted fifteen.
Basketball: the computer counted ten.
Tennis ball: the computer counted six.
Beanbag: the computer counted one. Plop!
Yes! The bouncy ball has the longest row. It's the bounciest ball!
Look again. Which row is the longest? Tap it.
Every ball has a count. Tap Show the chart!
Which ball is the bounciest? Tap its row.
Tap Again to count the same ball, or tap another ball and press Drop.
Tap the hand every time the ball hits the pad.
Compare the two counts. Tap Again to count the same ball once more.
Your paper count is fewer than the computer count. Tap Again to try the same ball.
Your paper count is more than the computer count. Tap Again to try the same ball.
Bouncy ball. Press Drop when you are ready.
Basketball. Press Drop when you are ready.
Tennis ball. Press Drop when you are ready.
Beanbag. Press Drop when you are ready.
Slow is on. The same bounces play at half speed.
Slow is off. The bounces play at normal speed.
Tap a row to choose the bounciest ball. Tap Back to gym to try another drop.
Me vs the Counter. Who counts better?
Counts stay here, on this device.
Every ball drops from the same height.
Bounce Lab. Bounciest Ball. Motion. Sound. Read. Drop. Bounce. Again. Slow. Our count. Show the chart. Start over. Skip.
